description: Search digital nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visas across countries, cheapest entry first. Filter by the most a person can show: monthly USD income for digital_nomad and retirement, USD investment for investor. Returns summary rows; use get_country_profile for full requirements.

countries.description: Only these countries. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

limit.description: How many visas to return, cheapest first within each type. Defaults to 25; count gives the total, so narrow with the filters above.

max_minimum_usd.description: Only visas whose entry minimum is at or below this.

max_presence.description: Only visas whose stay requirement to keep the residency is at most this: visits_only (occasional visits, a few days a year or less), part_year (regular stays, up to about 3 months a year or re-entry every 6 months), most_of_year. Visas without a rating, including digital nomad visas, drop out.

max_years_to_citizenship.description: Only visas with a path to citizenship of at most this many years of residency (the program's own figure, or for a digital nomad visa that counts toward permanent residency, the country's naturalization rule). Visas with no known path drop out.

passive_investment.description: true: only investor visas that accept a passive investment (no business to run). Other visa types drop out.

region.description: A region ("South America", "Central America", "North America", "Caribbean", "Europe") or "Latin America".

visa_type.description: Visa category to search. Defaults to "any".

name: find_visas
title: Find residency visas
